sloka: राजीव चित्र पृष्ठः स विरराज महामृगः ।राम आश्रम पद अभ्याशे विचचार यथा सुखम् ॥३-४२-२४॥
transliteration: rājīva citra pṛṣṭhaḥ sa virarāja mahāmṛgaḥ ।rāma āśrama pada abhyāśe vicacāra yathā sukham ॥3-42-24॥

translations.english: That magnificent deer glittered with the colour of blue lotus on its back, wandered merrily in the vicinity of Rama's hermitage.
